title: has_function_privilege does not track EXECUTE behaviour on procedures
label: REPRODUCED-TODAY

measurement.why: the probe was genuinely refused with 42501, and the role-named form of has_function_privilege answered true for the probe, for root, for admin and for public -- including for the role that had just been refused
measurement.procedure: mainline.merge_permit(UUID, BYTES, STRING, STRING, JSONB, BYTES, INT2, BYTES)

behavioural_truth_of_CALL.message: user upstream_probe_deb8e9c0 does not have EXECUTE privilege on procedure merge_permit

INSERT.message: user upstream_probe_deb8e9c0 does not have INSERT privilege on relation permit

transcript.what: revoke EXECUTE on the procedure from public
transcript.sql: REVOKE EXECUTE ON PROCEDURE mainline.merge_permit(UUID, BYTES, STRING, STRING, JSONB, BYTES, INT2, BYTES) FROM public

transcript.what: revoke EXECUTE on the procedure from upstream_probe_deb8e9c0
transcript.sql: REVOKE EXECUTE ON PROCEDURE mainline.merge_permit(UUID, BYTES, STRING, STRING, JSONB, BYTES, INT2, BYTES) FROM upstream_probe_deb8e9c0

transcript.what: read the procedure's access-control list after the revoke
transcript.sql: SELECT p.proacl::TEXT FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = p.pronamespace WHERE n.nspname = 'mainline' AND p.proname = 'merge_permit'
transcript.note: an access-control list (ACL) is the row of who-may-do-what the database keeps for an object; NULL here would mean 'nobody ever set one', which is the state the counter-reading in docs/demo/cr-gate-measurements.md was measured in

transcript.what: compare where the two functions would read from: the procedure's stored permission row vs the table's
transcript.sql: SELECT (SELECT p.proacl::TEXT FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = p.pronamespace         WHERE n.nspname = 'mainline' AND p.proname = 'merge_permit') AS proacl,        (SELECT c.relacl::TEXT FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace         WHERE n.nspname = 'mainline' AND c.relname = 'permit') AS relacl
transcript.note: the table has been granted SELECT and revoked nothing; the procedure has had EXECUTE revoked from everyone
